notes.title: Saturday & Sunday Scheduled Public Games!
notes.content:
[h1]Saturday & Sunday Public Game [/h1]

Hey guys! It's been a little while since we've last had an officially scheduled Saturday game. As you now can guess, we were busy finalizing the patch for release. Now that the patch is live, we can get back to having our Saturday pub games! If you haven't tried out the new patch yet, today's matches are a perfect opportunity to do so! The changelog for the patch can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/ns2combat/announcements/detail/130958205692794915]here[/url]. Give it a once over to check out what we've been working on, then hop in a game to experience them yourself!

We also recently dropped the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/ns2combat/announcements/detail/130958585815883294]price[/url] of NS2: Combat as well as the 4-pack, so tell your friends to pick up a copy...or 4!

Since we've begun to grow the community, we won't be doing two separate game times for EU and NA respectively. Instead we are going to announce a starting time and have continuous matches throughout the day. Join up when you're ready to show some skillz!


[b]Game Start Time:[/b] 
[list]
[*]NA Time Zone: 4:00 PM EST/1:00 PM PT
[*]EU Time Zone: 8:00 PM/20:00 UTC
[/list]
[b]Servers:[/b]
[list]
[*]We will be on whichever server is best suited for the majority of players at any one time
[/list]

We hope to see you there!

Edit: 

We are also adding Sunday to the official weekend scheduled line-up.

-----
NS2: Combat Development Team

notes.title: NS2: Combat 9.12.2015 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/615095545767960816/5E669A6B99091A457EE40FD66B86B168780476AF/[/img]

It's Finally here! After many months of work and testing, we have finally released the update that has been talked about so much. There are a lot of changes to Combat compared to the last build. We've overhauled the UI as well as how XP is rewarded and how the Hive/CC take damage. These changes are aimed at shrinking the level gap to insure everyone has fun playing as well as to eliminate stalemates and keep the game fun. 

There are many other changes that have been made. The changelog is posted below. If you haven't hopped into a game of Combat in awhile, now is the time!


-----
NS2: Combat Development Team


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[b]Alien Tweaks:[/b]

- Hydra health decreased from 610 to 500
- Hydra fuel drain decreased from 0.12 to 0.02
- Hydra minimum rate-of-fire set to 0.25 sec (overall rof nerfed)
- Whip unlock lowered from level 9 to level 4
- Fades can now Double jump
- Spore mine placement range slightly reduced
- Spore mine damage increased from 30 to 36
- Gorge spit damage decreased from 30 to 28
- Babblers from babbler bomb decreased from 3 to 2
- Babblers from babbler bomb are now hard capped to 6 per gorge
- Babblers skill level increased from 4 to 5.
- Acid rocket got a new damage type, does 4x damage to structures, and 2x damage to Exos.
- Acid rocket rate of fire increased 1.5x
- Acid rocket energy use increased 
- Removed Ink ability
- Onos charge now knocks marines out of the way
- Reduced the range of stomp form 12 to 11
- Crag self heal has been reduced slightly (it will still heal other objects and players the same amount)

[b]Marine Tweaks:[/b]

- Flamethrower damage and energy drain increased 
- Grenade launcher building damage now does 1.5x
- Cluster grenade damage increased from 50 to 75

notes.title: January Balance Update (#2!)
notes.content:
This month's updates mainly focuses on performance/stability improvements (in common with the Natural Selection 2 codebase) and balance. You asked for more detailed changelogs, so here's as much detail as we can muster!

[h1]Changelog for NS2: Combat January 2015 Balance Update 2[/h1]
Released on 2015-01-28
[b]Alien Tweaks:[/b]

[list]
[*]Hydra spikes damage decreased from 15 to 9
[*]Hydra fire rate decreased from .25 to .15
[*]Hydra health decreased from 610 to 475
[*]Hydra range decreased from 20 to 18
[*]Hydra fuel sap decreased from 17 to 12
[*]Hydra accuracy decreased 5%
[*]Gorge heal-spray reduced 15% for buildings.
[/list]

[b]Marine Tweaks:[/b]

[list]
[*]Flamethrower flammable target multiplier reduced to 2.25
[*]Flamethrower damage decreased from 15 to 14.5
[*]Flamethrower energy drain decreased from 2 to 1.7
[*]Grenade launcher building damage increased from 1x to 1.70x
[/list]

A preview version of our next map, co_niveus, is now included in the public build for your exploring pleasure!

[h1]Update 1[/h1]
Released on 2015-01-15
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a hole in the ready room on co_nest.
[/list]

[b]Alien Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hydra spikes now deplete Jetpack fuel at a rate of 17% per hit.
[*]Bile bomb damage to Command Chairs is reduced to 45% of normal.
[*]Clog health increased from 250 to 500.
[*]Hydra range increased from 17.78 to 20.
[*]Hydra armor increased from 10 to 13.
[*]Hydra health increased from 350 to 610.
[*]Hydras are now more accurate at hitting moving targets.
[*]Hydra minimum rate-of-fire set to 0.25sec.
[*]Focus unlock lowered from level 9 to level 5.
[*]Whip unlock lowered from level 9 to level 4.
[/list]

[b]Marine Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]The starting Marine Armory (not the weapon cache!) now repairs armor.
[*]Observatory detection range reduced from 22 to 15.
[*]Flamethrower building damage reduced by half
[*]Grenade launcher building damage reduced to same as player damage
[*]Cluster grenade damage reduced from 75 to 50.
[*]Cluster damage no longer does double damage to structures.
[*]Revolver damage reduced from 40 to 38.
[*]Revolver fire rate increased to the same as the Pistol.
[/list]

[b]General Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased Capture Mode points-to-win from 500 to 600.
[/list]

notes.content:

[i]Note to all server operators, you will probably want to add co_nest to your map rotations! Please edit your MapCycle.json file in "%APPDATA%\Roaming\NS2Combat" to do this. [/i]

[*]New official map: co_nest
[*]Tweaked the pistol fire rate

[*]Festive treats for Xmas!
[/list]
[b]Detailed Changelog to follow shortly...[/b]
